projects.title: Financial-document extraction
projects.summary: An AI workflow benchmarked against a task that took about three days of manual analysis.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: Reduce manual effort in extracting and checking financial information.

steps.title: Selection & screening
steps.subtitle: Who gets the support
steps.body: Profile each applicant before and at entry, so technical mentoring goes where it can change the outcome most.
steps.outcome: A clear starting profile for each startup: strengths, gaps and risk areas.

steps.title: Problem & challenges
steps.subtitle: What is really blocking them
steps.body: Work through the business use cases with the founders to surface both business problems and code-level bugs standing in the way.
steps.outcome: A prioritised problem list tied to business impact.

steps.title: Architecture review
steps.subtitle: Reading the whole system
steps.body: Review the full systems architecture end to end, from data and models to APIs, security and cloud footprint.
steps.outcome: Findings on weaknesses, risks and quick wins.

steps.title: Redesign & redevelop
steps.subtitle: Fixing it with the team
steps.body: Brainstorm the hard problems in computer vision, NLP and agentic AI, ML and end-to-end CI/CD, then redesign and redevelop the weakest components.
steps.outcome: A leaner, more maintainable architecture implemented alongside the team.

steps.title: Cloud & cost
steps.subtitle: Spend less, scale better
steps.body: Redesign the cloud architecture and optimise cost so the product scales without runaway spend.
steps.outcome: Lower cloud spend and an architecture that scales sensibly.

steps.title: Test, review & fix
steps.subtitle: Making it reliable
steps.body: Test the systems, review the code and fix bugs, so each release is dependable.

steps.title: EU AI Act
steps.subtitle: Risk by design
steps.body: Assess each product against the EU AI Act and redesign it to mitigate its risk levels.
steps.outcome: Mitigated risk levels and a compliance-ready design.

steps.title: Roadmap & readiness
steps.subtitle: Ready for the market
steps.body: Optimise the product roadmap and confirm the system is robust, reliable and fit for real-world use before investors and customers see it.
steps.outcome: An optimised roadmap and a product ready to scale.

award.title: NovaUCD Innovation Champion of the Year
award.body: The CeADAR EDIH for AI team, which I am part of, received the 2026 award for championing innovation and industry engagement. UCD President Professor Orla Feely presented it to EDIH Programme Manager Laura Plunkett on the team's behalf. The programme is co-funded by the EU Digital Europe Programme and Ireland's Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment through Enterprise Ireland.
